stages.title: Clause map
stages.body: Mark independent, dependent, restrictive and supplementary units before punctuating.

stages.title: Introductory commas
stages.body: Separate a substantial opening phrase or clause from the main clause.

stages.title: Coordinated clauses
stages.body: Use comma plus coordinator, semicolon or full stop rather than a comma splice.

stages.title: Relative information
stages.body: Use commas only for removable non-restrictive material.

stages.title: Lists and contrasts
stages.body: Use consistent list punctuation and commas that prevent misreading.

stages.title: Semicolon
stages.body: Join closely related independent clauses or separate complex list items.

stages.title: Colon
stages.body: Introduce an explanation, list or restatement after a complete announcing clause.

stages.title: Dash and brackets
stages.body: Use sparingly for interruption, emphasis or parenthetical clarification.

stages.title: Apostrophe
stages.body: Distinguish possession, contraction and ordinary plural.

stages.title: Quotation and terminal marks
stages.body: Preserve direct speech and question/statement status.

stages.title: Hyphen and ellipsis
stages.body: Hyphenate useful compound modifiers; use ellipsis only for omission.

stages.title: Capitalisation audit
stages.body: Capitalise proper names and formal titles, not generic importance.
